verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents per-account bank reconciliation: feeds or statement imports, categorization, and API operations to create and list bank reconciliations and get statement summaries. Uncategorized-transaction handling and bank-rule match filters imply a matched/unmatched workflow. Missing for 10: explicit surfacing of matched vs. unmatched transactions in a review view, any duplicate-transaction detection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
